heading: INT. ZERO-G LAUNDROMAT - ORBITAL HAB RING - NIGHT CYCLE

units.text: INT. ZERO-G LAUNDROMAT - ORBITAL HAB RING - NIGHT CYCLE
Washers hum on the walls like nesting beetles.
Clothes float in soapy spheres.
TANVEER and MBALI float by the dryers, arguing in whispers.
She jabs a finger at his chest.
He catches it, gently.
OSKAR clings to a handrail, pale, a laundry bag knotted around his wrist.
LIN drifts up from the aft hatch, holding a wrench, and cuts the whisper in half with her voice.
Who ran a wash with coolant in it?
units.name: LIN

units.text: Nobody answers.
She turns slowly in the air.
They all look at Oskar.
It was a blue bottle.
units.name: OSKAR

units.text: It was coolant.
units.name: LIN

units.text: DOC FENWICK, an old man in a cardigan, pushes off the far wall like a swimmer and catches a floating sock.
He examines it, sniffs it, and sighs.
Everybody out.
units.name: DOC FENWICK

units.text: RHEA, the youngest, laughs, then stops, then laughs harder.
The washer behind her shudders.
A warning light goes from green to red.
Mbali grabs Tanveer.
Lin grabs Oskar.
Doc Fenwick grabs the sock.
The machine bursts open and a pink cloud of foam rolls across the room, swallowing all six of them.
